about: The description of one hit: its damage, flags and the spell that made it.

evidence.says: RollAttackAgainstArmourClass (code:unplaced::RollAttackAgainstArmourClass) ors 1 into the hit record's +0x2C on a hit and 2|4 on a miss; Script Extender's HitDesc.EffectFlags read Hit|HitpointsDamaged for the pinned 15 and Dodge|Miss for the pinned 2 and for 15 against AC 21 (Ext.Enums.DamageFlags: Hit 1, Dodge 2, Miss 4, Critical 8)

Script Extender's HitDesc puts HitWith (uint8) at +0x4C; RollAttackAgainstArmourClass (code:unplaced::RollAttackAgainstArmourClass) writes 1 (HitWith Weapon) at the hit record's +0x4C only in its hit branch; a live miss read HitDesc.HitWith None

RollAttackAgainstArmourClass (code:unplaced::RollAttackAgainstArmourClass) appends with eoc::ConditionRolls::AddNew at the hit record's +0x50; Script Extender's HitDesc.ConditionRolls held that one element (MeleeWeaponAttack) after the hit
unplaced::EvaluateSpellRollOnTarget (code:unplaced::EvaluateSpellRollOnTarget) copies the spell's FixedString into the HitDesc it fills at +0x150 before the spell's roll is evaluated
during a goblin's weapon attack the HitDesc reached through +0x68 of the condition context holds Target_MainHandAttack's FixedString at +0x150 at the moment of the attack roll
